<!-- Generated by cargo xtask guide-check --write-reference. Do not edit. -->

Every setting, in the order the Settings tab shows them.

| Label | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.dark}} | Dark canvas and panels, the usual working look. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.light}} | Light canvas and panels, easier on printed previews. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.show_grid}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.interface_size}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.route_on}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.top}} | New tracks are drawn on the top copper layer. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.bottom}} | New tracks are drawn on the bottom copper layer. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.pad_labels}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.accent_color}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.reduce_motion}} | Turn off fades and gliding zoom. The wheel zooms in one step. Dragging is unchanged. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.chamfer_corners}} | On by default: routed corners are cut at 45 degrees, because right angles hurt signal quality and add emissions. Turn it off to allow right-angle corners. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.apply_board_dimensions}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.radius}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.add_hole}} | Cuts this round hole into the board. The checks keep copper and other holes clear of it, and undo takes the hole out again. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.copper_for_v0}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.pour_copper}} | Pours this rectangle of copper onto the board. It joins every wire and pad it touches to the chosen connection, and undo pours it away again. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.what_to_print}} | The words to print on the board. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.at}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.side}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.add_label}} | Prints these words on the board at the chosen spot. Undo erases it again. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.words_on_the_board}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.text_v0}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.erase}} | Wipe this word off the board. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.back_to_a_plain_rectangle}} | Trade the drawn board edge for the simple rectangle sized by W and H above. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.drawing_file_path_svg}} | A vector drawing whose edge can become the board outline, or whose shapes can be laid onto the board as artwork. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.import_drawing}} | Lay the shapes from the drawing file onto the board as editable artwork. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.import_as_board_edge}} | Trace the closed shape in the drawing file into the board outline. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.cutout_radius}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.erc_electrical_drc_board}} | Open the checks tab for the full list of findings. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.folder_for_the_files_blank}} | Where the make files land. Leave blank to use a folder named outputs next to the design file. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.copper_drill_files}} | The Gerber copper layers, board outline and drill file a board house asks for. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.parts_list_csv}} | A spreadsheet of every part: one row per unique part with all its references. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.net_list}} | A plain text list of every connection and the pins on it. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.pick_and_place_file}} | Where every part sits, which way it faces and which side it goes on, for the assembly machine. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.design_report}} | A readable summary of the whole design: board, every part and every connection. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.drill_map_csv}} | Every hole on the board counted and grouped by size, so you can sanity-check the drill sizes before the board goes away. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.drill_map}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.3d_model_step}} | The standard 3D file for mechanical programs and free viewers. It lands in the make folder. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.3d_model}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.3d_viewer_file}} | A lighter 3D file that simple viewers open quickly. It lands in the make folder. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.printable_drawing_pdf}} | A one-page drawing of the finished board you can print or email. It lands in the make folder. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.printable_drawing}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.web_drawing_svg}} | A crisp picture of the board that any web browser can show, at any size. It lands in the make folder. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.web_drawing}} |  |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.print_art_top_silkscreen}} | Writes the top silkscreen as true-size artwork for a UV printer: a transparent colour picture, a white-ink picture and a drawing, all in the make folder. Text outlines are not included yet. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.print_art_bottom_silkscreen}} | Writes the bottom silkscreen as true-size artwork for a UV printer, not mirrored, because the printer looks at the real board. It lands in the make folder. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.across}} | Set how many copies of the board sit side by side on the panel. From 1 to 32. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.down}} | Set how many copies of the board sit top to bottom on the panel. From 1 to 32. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.mm_gap}} | Empty space between neighbouring copies, room for cutting them apart later. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.mm_rail}} | Solid border left around the edge of the panel, where the factory grips it. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.preview_panel}} | Work out the panel size and where every copy lands, using the board's own measurements. The design itself is left alone. |
| {{ui:settings.settings_tab.copies_copies_panel_width_height}} | The finished panel: its overall size and how many boards fit on it. |
